notes: DataObj::Update: all four switch cases and the default. The track words (+0x28..+0x34) come from the decoder cursor's parameter block (cursor +0x04..+0x10, now DecoderCursorInterface::params_) in every case, as the listing does. Null stream or decoder is treated as a failed step (the listing would fault there).

Returns the engine int, 0 on the null path (m_internal is 0 there, as the listing returns it). Missing: the target VoxEngineInternal::SetInteractiveMusicState (0x86764c) is partial (a non-zero data state word makes the binary call a null decoder; the port skips that call).

SequentialGroup::GetGroupElementPosition: advance, wrap, cycle and saved-state writes match the listing. Missing item: with an empty element vector the listing reads element 0 through a null begin pointer; the port returns -1 instead.

UpdateOldSegmentState: copy of record C into B, play mode 2, zeroed record for no rule or non-positive frames, state 4. Missing item: the rule branch with frames (the rule-kind switch, cases 4, 5, 6 and default, over the vector<int> copy of the loop-list entry at a1+0x2c, and the ramp sums).

ParseFile: header block (magic, body size, name words +0x0c..+0x17, base offset), Afmt id and size (+0x1c, +0x20), fmt words and bytes past +0x2f (fmt_tail), and the chunk walk are in place. Missing item: a Trsn chunk with no Stat chunk; the listing passes an uninitialised stack word as the transition count, the port passes 0.

DecoderNativeCursor C1: parse on first use, playlist manager copy, PCM (1) or IMA ADPCM (17) sub-decoder with two states, track parameters from the sub-decoder, frame capacity 600 * channels * word 2 / 500. A failed parse leaves the cursor without a sub-decoder (the listing zeroes the first counters; the port leaves them at their defaults). Header words now come from ParseFile's header block.
DecoderNativeCursor C2: same body as C1 (0x8742f4). Reconstructed on the same basis.

SetPlayCursor: source Reset, SetByteOffset (channels * bytes * frames), decoder Seek, state 2 to 3, and the Mutex::Unlock result, using the cursor parameter block (+0x04..+0x10). Missing item: when the data object state (+0x50) is not 0 the listing calls GetType on a null decoder (a fault); the port skips the seek on that path.

blocked: three named items. (1) Cursor slot +0x20 takes the float dt and returns a frame count; the port's GetRewindLimit has no argument. (2) Source slot +0x4c is called with two int out-pointers (a fill query), while the port names +0x4c FreeDisposableData. (3) The byte at +0x145 (flag_145_) selects the interactive-state path and its role is not identified.

Missing item: when the data object state word (+0x50) is not 0 the binary calls the decoder GetType slot on a null decoder; the port skips the call on that path. Otherwise the native-decoder cursor call and SetInteractiveMusicStateChange follow the pseudocode; returns the release int.

ApplyTransitionRule: kind-1 branch (next-dying test, transpose, previous-state reset, swap, element lookup, frame count check) and the other kind's reset and lookup. The element is copied with the rule's kind and field_08 words. The listing returns an int that its only caller does not read, so the port returns void.

Musepack-range register-aliased state machine (about 7 KB Ghidra pseudocode, self-jumps through FUN_008a7e90, table reads via mpc_bits_read, mpc_random_int fill). Entry is not an IDA label (asm lookup fails), and the struct layouts behind r4/r5/r11 are not identified, so no port. Needs IDA asm review first.
